title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 14 and Article 47 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en: I. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall undertake the statutory duties of safeguarding national security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and shall have the power to make judgments and decisions on whether a matter involves national security, and its work information shall not be made public. Decisions made by the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall not be subject to judicial review and shall have enforceable legal effect. No administrative, legislative, judicial or other institutions, organizations, or individuals in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall interfere with the work of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and shall all respect and execute the decisions of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

II. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 47 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, where, in the trial of cases involving crimes that endanger national security, a court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region encounters issues concerning the determination of whether an act involves national security or whether relevant evidence materials involve State secrets, it shall refer the matter to the Chief Executive and obtain a certificate issued by the Chief Executive on such issues, and the aforesaid certificate shall be binding on the court.

III. The relevant report submitted by the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to the Central People's Government on November 28 pursuant to the provisions of Article 11 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region considers that overseas lawyers who do not possess full qualification to practice in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, when acting as defenders or litigation agents in cases of crimes that endanger national security, may pose a national security risk. The issue of whether overseas lawyers who do not possess full qualification to practice in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may serve as defenders or litigation agents in cases of crimes that endanger national security falls within the matters requiring determination as provided in Article 47 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and a certificate issued by the Chief Executive shall be obtained. If a court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has not referred the matter to the Chief Executive and obtained a certificate issued by the Chief Executive on such issues, the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall, pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, perform its statutory duties and make relevant judgments and decisions on such circumstances and issues.
This is hereby announced.
